rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The Kremlin item of 14 September 2007 states that Zubkov's candidacy was submitted by the head of state to the lower house of parliament on Wednesday, 12 September, after the previous head of the cabinet, M. Fradkov, resigned.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The item states that earlier on 14 September 2007 the State Duma consented to Zubkov's appointment as premier.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The item, dated 14 September 2007, 15:00, reports that the President signed the decree appointing Viktor Zubkov Chairman of the Government of Russia.
